summary.text: Travis Groo, a Libertarian Party transportation worker, lost the November 3, 2026 election for North Carolina's 11th Congressional District to Jamie Ager.
He has run as a Libertarian for the North Carolina legislature several times.

paragraphs.text: Travis Groo earned a bachelor's degree from the University of West Florida in 2000 and lists transportation as his profession.

Groo ran as the Libertarian candidate for North Carolina House District 11 in 2018 and for North Carolina Senate District 17 in 2020, and was listed as a withdrawn Libertarian candidate for North Carolina House District 41 in 2022. In 2024 he was the Libertarian candidate for North Carolina House District 36, receiving 1,521 votes out of 52,514 cast.
He was on the November 3, 2026 ballot for the 11th Congressional District after the Libertarian primary was canceled.
In his Ballotpedia survey, he listed balancing the budget, eliminating the income tax and abolishing Certificate of Need laws as his key messages.
He received 1.6% of the vote to Jamie Ager's 57.1%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
